EmailTemplate.subject: Admission Information for Master of Arts in Social Technologies at ASU
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Greetings. It is my pleasure to inform you that after careful evaluation of our applicants, we are pleased to recommend your admission to the Master of Arts in Social Technologies at Arizona State University. Although you should consider this notice an unofficial acceptance (to be followed by official acceptance via email from the ASU Graduate College), please accept my hearty congratulations on behalf of the Graduate Studies Admissions Committee.
As Director of the M.A. in Social Technologies, I welcome you to our program and invite you to contact me with any questions you may have concerning your admission. Prior to the start of the semester, we have scheduled a mandatory orientation meeting. At this gathering, I will provide information to help you has you begin the process of earning your M.A.. In addition, you will be able to meet your fellow entering students and to ask questions about the program.
You will find answers to many of your questions in the program handbook - https://newcollege.asu.edu/sites/default/files/files/advising/documents/mast_graduate_handbook_2015-16.pdf. If you have additional questions related to tuition, financial aid or housing, please view the next steps section found here https://newcollege.asu.edu/graduate/admission-next-steps for a number of University Offices available to assist you. If you have questions related to the program or registration, please contact the Academic Success Coordinator, Jan Lacey, at ncgradadvising@asu.edu.
In the meantime, congratulations! I look forward to meeting you at orientation and click here for your next steps. https://newcollege.asu.edu/graduate/admission-next-steps
Please take a moment and complete the form to either accept or decline our offer of admission. https://newcollege.asu.edu/graduate/acceptance-form
Alex Halavais, PhD Professor & Director of MA in Social Technologies Program School of Social and Behavioral Sciences Email: alex@halavais.net
